verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service with public web documentation could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows an llms.txt file or any agent-facing documentation. The probes found that both ohiosos.gov and the Ohio Business Central filing portal answer even robots.txt with HTTP 403 (the portal also returned 404 on one same-day request). The cited Gateway and tax pages are human-oriented portal tips only.
